newsitem.title: UK: FORECAST-GEC H1 profits edge ahead.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST-GEC H1 profits edge ahead.

text.p: The General Electric Co Plc wipes the slate clean for new managing director George Simpson with the reporting of first-half results next Friday.

Analysts say the figures will be notable for being the last set of results before Simpson took over on September 9 from the diversified electronics to industrial power group's veteran helmsman Lord Weinstock.

Pretax profits are expected to show a modest advance to between 418 and 430 million stg, from 402 million stg last time, yielding a dividend of 3.25-3.35 pence a share, up from 3.1p last time, covered by earnings of 9.5p.
